topic: Starman Tesla Roadster orbiting the Sun
hook: Your car stays home. A Tesla orbits the Sun.
title: A Tesla has orbited the Sun since 2018
description:
In February 2018 SpaceX launched a red Tesla Roadster on a Falcon Heavy rocket. In the driver's seat is a mannequin called Starman, and the car is still travelling around the Sun. Series: If You Were in Space.

#Shorts #SpaceX #Space
